plantedFootMeasure.method: plantedFootTilesPerSecond: ankle bones, stance = low and moving backward relative to the hips, speed in ground tiles/s at the exported durationsMs (x playback of the baked cycle). plantedFootPixelTrackTilesPerSecond: independent cross-check from tracking sole clusters on the exported 2D silhouettes (props hidden), backward runs >= 4 frames, linear fit, inverse projection; low confidence where feet overlap or a skirt hides the boots.

footGate.criterion: continuous time; body at walkSpeed; playback = speed / plantedFootTilesPerSecond (cap maxPlayback); sprite drawn at the rounded body position; stance foot ground position sampled at each sprite-frame change; per contact phase max drift from the first sample <= maxDriftPx and net foot speed <= maxSpeedRatio of the body speed
